installCommand: curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/getzola/zola/releases/latest | grep -oP '"browser_download_url":\s*"\K[^"]*linux-musl\.tar\.gz' | head -n1 | xargs curl -fsSL | tar -xz
buildCommand: DRAFTS=$([ "$VERCEL_ENV" != "production" ] && echo "--drafts" || true) && ./zola build --base-url "$([ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ] && echo "https://blog.razzle.cloud" || echo "https://$VERCEL_URL")" $DRAFTS --minify
